explanation: The data has $8$ values in order, so it splits into a lower half and an upper half of $4$ values each.
The lower half is $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$, and $Q_1$ is the median of this half.
Four values have two in the middle, $2$ and $3$, so average them: $(2 + 3) \div 2 = 2.5$.
The lower quartile of the data is $Q_1 = 2.5$.
